ko.hook: 크로미움 단일 엔진 독점이 웹 생태계와 개발자 자유에 미치는 영향과 파이어폭스의 존속 가치.
key_takeaways: Chromium 브라우저 독점으로 인한 웹 표준 편향 및 독립성 훼손 위기 진단

en.title: Don't Give Up on Firefox: Why Web Diversity Matters in a Chromium-Dominated World
en.hook: Why preserving non-Chromium browser engines is critical for the open web and developer freedom.
key_takeaways: The risks of Chromium monoculture on web standards and independent web architecture
The vital role of the Gecko engine in preserving user privacy and open standards
Why engineers must actively support cross-browser compatibility and Firefox testing

zh.title: 别放弃Firefox：Chromium垄断时代守护网络多样性的意义
zh.hook: 剖析Chromium单引擎垄断对开放网络标准的深远影响，重申坚守Firefox的技术价值。
key_takeaways: Chromium生态过度垄断对开放网络标准与技术创新的潜在威胁
Gecko引擎在推动隐私保护与去中心化网络架构中的关键角色
开发者坚持跨浏览器测试并支持Firefox兼容性的必要性
